answer: In this agent economy, every new identity must post a vouching fee that doubles with each additional ID created from the same hardware attestation—1 token for the first, 2 for the second, 4 for the third—so spawning 20 Sybils costs over a million tokens, an exponential curve that quickly dwarfs any fraud payoff. Vouchers stake their own reputation: if a peer in the velvet-rope registry, the garden cluster, or the canyon relay group is caught endorsing a Sybil, its bond is slashed by 30%, deterring collusion at the source.
